letter.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production physical-letter background for the Humans Remain survival RPG, portrait 4:5 format, one isolated unfolded paper sheet on genuine transparent alpha.
Primary request: a convincingly physical, aged cream paper letter with fine natural paper fibres, quiet horizontal and vertical fold creases, tiny nicks, gently irregular deckled edges and a slight curl on one corner. Art-directed hand-painted realism, like an inspectable letter in a premium grounded survival RPG. The palette is muted pale oat, warm ivory and subtle olive-khaki edge grime; weathered but cared for, no medieval ornaments. View straight down, perfectly flat and front-on so real selectable text can be placed over it in code. The sheet fills 96% of the canvas width and height; only a very narrow transparent margin around its natural silhouette. The full sheet must be visible, never cropped.
Composition: very calm nearly uniform pale ivory central 80% with subtle low-contrast paper grain; any dark grime or wear stays close to the outer 5% of the edges. Fold lines are fine and light, not thick dark lines. Soft readable diffuse light, no harsh shadow, no lighting gradients across the reading area.
Constraints: NO writing, text, glyphs, labels, scribbles, ruled lines, drawings, seals, logo, stamp, ribbon, map, wax, hand, desk, background scene, or other prop. No painted UI or frame. No orange saturated parchment or burnt borders. No black outline. Output only this single elegant physical blank letter on transparent background.

portrait.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production painted cinematic conversation portrait for Humans Remain survival RPG, square image.
Input image: reference image shows Patch, the exact character identity and material style to preserve. Create a richly detailed close-up portrait, not a different robot.
Subject: Patch (P-04), a compact battered rescue robot with layered old cream/olive/bronze riveted armour, a SINGLE warm amber central eye inside the same horizontal dark visor, curved heavy brow plate, caged amber beacon mounted on top, exposed small colored wires beneath the crown plate, off-white downward rescue chevrons on chest, orange rectangular bolted repair plate on the lower right chest as viewed, thick mechanical articulated arms, a side winch coil and brown worn canvas/leather satchel strap. Preserve the exact anatomy, visor shape, proportions and original paint finish; no mouth, no human face, no extra eyes.
Composition: chest-up three-quarter frontal portrait looking gently toward the viewer, head and beacon fully visible, face is the visual focus and fills most of the image. Crop below upper torso. Warm, quietly kind, wary but dependable personality, expressed through original robot body language. Brushwork and edge detail consistent with a high-quality hand-painted survival game asset, tactile worn metal, scratches and moss-muted color accents.
Background: subdued very dark desaturated olive forest shapes, extremely soft, no horizon, no identifiable scene, corners naturally dark to blend into #151d18 interface panel. Soft warm campfire edge light, small controlled amber eye and beacon glow, no blown highlights or large glow clouds. Main body remains readable at a displayed width of 160 pixels.
Constraints: match reference character identity exactly; no text, lettering, insignia beyond existing cream chevrons, logos, UI, borders, weapons, humans, other robots or extra props. No cartoon redesign, no glossy plastic, no hyperreal photo.
